name: executive-deck
description: Five-slide story arc: title cover, chapter divider, two-column argument (body + visual placeholder), big-stat moment, ask slide. Editorial / pitch tone.
when_to_use: Board pitch, investor update, strategy proposal, internal kickoff. When the brief says 'pitch deck', 'executive summary deck', 'strategy presentation', or names a multi-slide story.

slot_hints.label: Title slide headline
slot_hints.example: Our case for the next 12 months.

slot_hints.label: Body slide headline
slot_hints.example: The new shape of the workflow.

slot_hints.label: Body slide bullets (numbered, separated by blank lines)
Stat caption
slot_hints.example: Teams shipping production work after adopting the integrated design system.
